elements.label: Figure 4.15
elements.description:
Two grouped bar charts titled 'Continuity of education across regions and socioeconomic groups'. Y-axis on both panels: 'Share of affected households (%)', scale 0 to 100 in steps of 20. X-axis categories on both panels: No distance learning; Online live class; SMS; Paper-based self-learning; Other.

Panel A: 'Access to distance learning, by income quintile'. Legend: Bottom 20, Q2, Q3, Q4, Top 20. Approximate values (none printed):
- No distance learning: Bottom 20 ~31, Q2 ~26, Q3 ~19, Q4 ~12, Top 20 ~8
- Online live class: Bottom 20 ~38, Q2 ~53, Q3 ~58, Q4 ~75, Top 20 ~81
- SMS: Bottom 20 ~13, Q2 ~10, Q3 ~17, Q4 ~12, Top 20 ~12
- Paper-based self-learning: Bottom 20 ~28, Q2 ~15, Q3 ~14, Q4 ~9, Top 20 ~7
- Other: Bottom 20 ~4, Q2 ~9, Q3 ~5, Q4 ~7, Top 20 ~5
Pattern: online live class is the most common mode in every quintile and rises steadily with income, while no distance learning and paper-based self-learning fall as income rises.

Panel B: 'Access to distance learning, by region'. Legend: Red River Delta; Northern & Coastal Central; Southeastern Area; Midlands & Northern Mountains; Central Highlands; Mekong Delta. Approximate values (none printed):
- No distance learning: Red River Delta ~4, Northern & Coastal Central ~32, Southeastern Area ~12, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~22, Central Highlands ~35, Mekong Delta ~36
- Online live class: Red River Delta ~86, Northern & Coastal Central ~43, Southeastern Area ~71, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~41, Central Highlands ~41, Mekong Delta ~41
- SMS: Red River Delta ~11, Northern & Coastal Central ~14, Southeastern Area ~16, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~16, Central Highlands ~9, Mekong Delta ~10
- Paper-based self-learning: Red River Delta ~6, Northern & Coastal Central ~18, Southeastern Area ~12, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~29, Central Highlands ~20, Mekong Delta ~14
- Other: Red River Delta ~5, Northern & Coastal Central ~6, Southeastern Area ~4, Midlands & Northern Mountains ~8, Central Highlands ~6, Mekong Delta ~9
Pattern: the Red River Delta and Southeastern Area have the highest online live class shares, while the Midlands & Northern Mountains and Central Highlands have the highest no-distance-learning and paper-based shares.

Note: Household welfare quintiles (Q) are based on household consumption per capita in 2018. SMS = Short Message Service. Source: World Bank Vietnam COVID-19 household monitoring surveys (round 5, March 2021).
